blocks.label: text
blocks.text: An overview of Wezenla and why it is authorised in the EU
section_path: Wezenla (ustekinumab)
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
section_path: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Wezenla is a medicine used to treat:
section_path: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: moderate to severe plaque psoriasis (a disease causing red, scaly patches on the skin). It is used in adults and children above the age of 6 years whose condition has not improved with, or who cannot use, other systemic (whole-body) psoriasis treatments, such as ciclosporin, methotrexate or PUVA (psoralen ultraviolet A). PUVA is a type of treatment where the patient receives a medicine called psoralen, before being exposed to ultraviolet light;
section_path: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: active psoriatic arthritis (inflammation of the joints associated with psoriasis) in adults, when the condition has not improved enough with other treatments called disease-modifying anti-rheumatic drugs (DMARDs). Wezenla may be used alone or combined with methotrexate (a DMARD);
section_path: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: list_item
blocks.text: moderately to severely active Crohn's disease (a disease-causing inflammation of the gut) in adults and children weighing at least 40 kg whose condition has not improved enough with other treatments or who cannot receive such treatments.
section_path: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Wezenla contains the active substance ustekinumab and is a biological medicine. It is a 'biosimilar medicine'; this means that Wezenla is highly similar to another biological medicine (the 'reference medicine') that is already authorised in the EU. The reference medicine for Wezenla is Stelara. For more information on biosimilar medicines, see here.
section_path: What is Wezenla and what is it used for?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How is Wezenla used?
section_path: How is Wezenla used?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Wezenla can only be obtained with a prescription and should be given under the supervision of a doctor who has experience in diagnosing and treating the diseases that Wezenla is used for.
section_path: How is Wezenla used?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In plaque psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, Wezenla is injected under the skin. The first injection is followed by another injection 4 weeks later. After that, one injection is given every 12 weeks.
section_path: How is Wezenla used?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In Crohn's disease, treatment is started Wezenla as an infusion (drip) into a vein lasting at least 1 hour. Eight weeks after the first infusion, Wezenla is given as an injection under the skin. Patients then continue with Wezenla injected under the skin every 8 or 12 weeks depending on how well the treatment is working.
section_path: How is Wezenla used?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.text: Patients or their caregivers may inject Wezenla once they have been trained, if their doctor thinks that this is appropriate. For more information about using Wezenla, see the package leaflet or contact your doctor or pharmacist.
section_path: How is Wezenla used?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: How does Wezenla work?
section_path: How does Wezenla work?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The active substance in Wezenla, ustekinumab, is a monoclonal antibody, a type of protein that has been designed to recognise and attach to a specific target in the body. Ustekinumab attaches to 2 messenger molecules in the immune system called interleukin 12 and interleukin 23. Both are involved in inflammation and other processes that are important in psoriasis, psoriatic arthritis and Crohn's disease. By attaching to them and blocking their activity, ustekinumab reduces the activity of the immune system and the symptoms of the disease.
section_path: How does Wezenla work?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What benefits of Wezenla have been shown in studies?
section_path: What benefits of Wezenla have been shown in studies?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Laboratory studies comparing Wezenla with Stelara have shown that the active substance in Wezenla is highly similar to that in Stelara in terms of structure, purity and biological activity. Studies have also shown that giving Wezenla produces similar levels of the active substance in the body to giving Stelara.
section_path: What benefits of Wezenla have been shown in studies?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: In addition, a study in 563 patients with moderate to severe plaque psoriasis showed that Wezenla was as effective as Stelara in treating this condition. After 12 weeks improvement in symptom scores (PASI) was around 82% in patients given either of these medicines.
section_path: What benefits of Wezenla have been shown in studies?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Because Wezenla is a biosimilar medicine, the studies on effectiveness of ustekinumab carried out with Stelara do not all need to be repeated for Wezenla.
section_path: What benefits of Wezenla have been shown in studies?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What are the risks associated with Wezenla?
section_path: What are the risks associated with Wezenla?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The safety of Wezenla has been evaluated and, on the basis of all the studies carried out, the side effects of the medicine are considered to be comparable to those of the reference medicine Stelara.
section_path: What are the risks associated with Wezenla?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: For the complete list of side effects and restrictions of Wezenla, see the package leaflet.
section_path: What are the risks associated with Wezenla?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The most common side effects with ustekinumab (seen in more than 1 in 20 people during clinical trials) include headache and nasopharyngitis (inflammation of the nose and throat). The most serious side effect reported is serious hypersensitivity (allergic reaction).
section_path: What are the risks associated with Wezenla?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: Why is Wezenla authorised in the EU?
section_path: Why is Wezenla authorised in the EU?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: The European Medicines Agency decided that, in accordance with EU requirements for biosimilar medicines, Wezenla has a highly similar structure, purity and biological activity to Stelara and is distributed in the body in the same way. In addition, studies in plaque psoriasis have shown that Wezenla and Stelara are equivalent in terms of safety and effectiveness for this condition.
section_path: Why is Wezenla authorised in the EU?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: All these data were considered sufficient to conclude that Wezenla will have the same effects as Stelara in its authorised uses. Therefore, the Agency's view was that, as for Stelara, the benefits of Wezenla outweigh the identified risks and it can be authorised for use in the EU.
section_path: Why is Wezenla authorised in the EU?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: section_header
blocks.text: What measures are being taken to ensure the safe and effective use of Wezenla?
section_path: What measures are being taken to ensure the safe and effective use of Wezenla?
blocks.speaker: regulator

blocks.label: text
blocks.text: Recommendations and precautions to be followed by healthcare professionals and patients for the safe and effective use of Wezenla have been included in the summary of product characteristics and the package leaflet. As for all medicines, data on the use of Wezenla are continuously monitored. Suspected side effects reported with Wezenla are carefully evaluated and any necessary action taken to protect patients.
section_path: What measures are being taken to ensure the safe and effective use of Wezenla?
blocks.speaker: regulator
